tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: The page ground behind everything. Every chart palette in this system was validated against these two values specifically.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Result cards, panels, table bodies. The ground for status text.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: file drop zones, empty states, table headers.

tokens.name: surface-plot
tokens.usage: The plot area inside a chart. Kept distinct from surface-card so a chart reads as a figure, not a patch of card.

tokens.name: line-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, table rules, chart gridlines. Recessive by design; never use it for a control edge.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, buttons and checkboxes. Meets 3:1 against surface-card in both themes, which line-hairline does not.

tokens.name: ink-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, result values, anything the reader must not miss. 18.5:1 on surface-card in light.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy and the plain-English meaning line under a result.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Axis labels, captions, units, timestamps. Holds 4.9:1 on surface-page in light; do not go lighter.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on a filled status block or a solid series mark.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Normal / healthy. Always paired with the word, never used alone.

tokens.name: status-watch
tokens.usage: Degraded but operable; inspect at next service. Amber was darkened from the obvious value to clear 3:1 on white.

tokens.name: status-alert
tokens.usage: Fault detected; act. A true red, not an orange - see the README, an orange alert is indistinguishable from watch under colour-vision deficiency.

tokens.name: status-unknown
tokens.usage: No prediction: file unreadable, model not loaded, out of scope. Never show a fourth colour for this - grey means the system does not know.

tokens.name: status-ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for an OK chip. status-ok text on it clears 4.5:1.

tokens.name: status-watch-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a Watch chip.

tokens.name: status-alert-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for an Alert chip.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: First categorical slot. Assign in fixed order and never cycle; a filter that removes a series must not repaint the survivors.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Second categorical slot.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Third categorical slot.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Fourth categorical slot. There is no fifth: a fifth series folds into Other, or the chart becomes small multiples.

tokens.name: subsystem-shm
tokens.usage: SHM identity, for navigation and page headers only. Never inside a chart that encodes severity.

tokens.name: subsystem-acv
tokens.usage: ACV identity, navigation only.

tokens.name: subsystem-rail
tokens.usage: Rail Corrugation identity, navigation only.

tokens.name: subsystem-door
tokens.usage: Door identity, navigation only.

tokens.name: ramp-1
tokens.usage: Sequential magnitude, lightest step. Damage gauges, axle-box heat, per-car severity. One hue, ordered by lightness.

tokens.name: ramp-2
tokens.usage: Sequential magnitude, step 2.

tokens.name: ramp-3
tokens.usage: Sequential magnitude, step 3.

tokens.name: ramp-4
tokens.usage: Sequential magnitude, step 4.

tokens.name: ramp-5
tokens.usage: Sequential magnitude, darkest step. Highest value in the ramp.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px, offset 2px. Never removed without a replacement.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: The system name on the cover, and nothing else.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Page title on a subsystem screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card headings, chart titles. A chart title names its single series so no legend box is needed.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: The plain-English meaning line under a result.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary detail inside dense cards and tables.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and chip text. Set in sentence case, not upper, except inside a status chip.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Figure captions and provenance lines - the split method, the data hash, the model version.

styles.name: metric-xl
styles.usage: The one number a screen is about. Mono so digits do not shift width as a live value updates.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Secondary figures: CV score, segment count, file size.

styles.name: tabular
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and prediction previews. Always mono, always right-aligned.

styles.name: axis
styles.usage: Chart tick labels. Set in ink-muted, never in a series colour.

spacing.note: A 4px base grid. Chart geometry - tick pitch, bar gaps, grid spacing - is cut from these steps so figures align with the layout around them.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a status dot and its label; the 2px-doubled surface gap between adjacent fills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a chip; between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between stacked rows in a dense list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on small cards; the minimum side gutter on any screen.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on result cards; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a chart and the prose below it.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between major sections of a subsystem page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Data ends: the rounded cap on a bar, anchored at the baseline end only.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, axle-box cells, car blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips and filter pills.

shadow.note: Two elevations only. This system prefers a hairline border to a shadow; a shadow means the element genuinely floats.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards. Subtle enough that the hairline still does the work.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Chart tooltips and menus, which genuinely sit above the page.

stroke.note: Line weights for chart marks. Thin by default: the data should carry the weight, not the ink.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Gridlines and axis rules, in line-hairline.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: Line-series stroke. The standard data line weight.

tokens.name: stroke-emph
tokens.usage: The one highlighted series in a comparison, or a selected segment.

tokens.name: stroke-gap
tokens.usage: The surface-coloured gap between adjacent fills and the ring on overlapping marks.
